title: Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.21646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. translated_abstract: 我们推出了 Limite 1B - Violetto，这是一个专为高吞吐量数学推理设计的十亿参数模型。Limite 在一个精心策划、以数学为核心的语料库上从头训练，共使用了 2370 亿个 token，并支持最长 131k token 的上下文长度。其架构与训练方案是协同开发的，旨在最大化推理能力的同时保持训练和推理成本较低。后训练阶段结合了知识蒸馏、针对性的监督微调以及在精选课程上的 RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）。Limite 在 AIME 2026 上取得了 94.01% 的成绩，在 BeyondAIME 上取得了 74.25% 的成绩，在我们的评测套件中跻身于参数量为其数倍的模型之列。该模型刻意只进行了轻度的指令微调：它主要被定位为单轮数学求解器以及大型系统中快速并行运行的组件，而非通用助手。我们发布了该模型、其基础模型和价值模型检查点，以及一套经过优化的服务栈。
tldr: Limite 1B - Violetto 是一个仅 10 亿参数的数学推理模型，通过在精心策划的数学语料上从头训练，并结合知识蒸馏、监督微调与 RLVR 后训练，在 AIME 2026 上取得 94.01% 的成绩，性能媲美参数量数倍于它的模型。
en_tdlr: Limite 1B - Violetto is a 1-billion-parameter math reasoning model trained from scratch on 237 billion curated math-centric tokens with knowledge distillation, targeted SFT, and RLVR, achieving 94.01% on AIME 2026 and rivaling models many times its size.
